title: A comparison of the airborne bacterial communities in suburban homes, farmers’ homes, and pigsties
description: We sampled airborne dust from Danish pigsties, associated farmers’ homes, and control suburban homes (267 samples total) and carried out MiSeq sequencing of the V3-V4 region of bacterial 16S rRNA genes found in these samples.
